item.tib: bla chen dran pa gsang sgrub kyi dbang khrid dngos grub gter mdzod mthong ba don gsal
item.coloph: de ltar bla chen gsang sgrab kyis (kyi/)dbang khrid mthong ba don gsal zhes bya ba 'di/ bru yi gtsug rgyan rgyal rigs bru'i rgyal gshen chen po lhun grub rgyal po'i bka'i (bkas) bskul ba la brten nas/ mkhas btsun rnam dag ming can gyis/ gnas mchog dam pa dpal ldan mkhar sna'i dgon du dge sbyor gyi thun mtshams su/ bsgrigs pa la sgro bskur med pa sdom pa re zhig rdzogs so/ gsang ba dbang gi khrid kha rgyas bsdus 'bring po gsum du bsgrigs pa la/ 'di ni shin tu rgyas pa'o//
